source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Write out incident details in chronological order.
3. Begin a paragraph from the event and continue writing. No commas, put one event next to the other.
4. Describe the event as if you are the event and use verbs.
5. Do not skip the steps, be complete.
6. For a sequence of events, start typing a sentence describing the first event. Then write out the second event. Put a period and start on the next line. Repeat the actions and put a period after each event. The list will be a bullet list.
7. Review the event checklist and look for missing information. Add the missing information.
8. Add quotes and add details inside of quotes only when it is important that the reader cannot miss the event.
9. Add any documents that are relevant as attachments. If you do not have scan copies of the document, take a photograph and attach the photo of the document to the report
